core_obligations: Auxiliary rule (proof lines 788-796): the case definition of xi on non-functions, successor-domain functions (apply tau to the last value) and limit-domain functions (apply theta to the range).
Invoke recursion (lines 797-799): the transfinite recursion schema supplies sigma with sigma(alpha) = xi(sigma restricted to alpha).

Verify the three equations (lines 801-811): sigma of empty unfolds to A; at a successor the restriction's value at alpha is sigma(alpha), so tau applies; at a limit xi reads the range of the restriction, which is exactly theta of it.
proof_roadmap: Package the three desired clauses into a single one-step functional xi.
Feed xi to the general recursion schema.
Check the empty, successor and limit cases against the construction.
